facts.fact: 茶铺里 Stella 一唱一和逗 Maeve（Who are we to judge?），Maeve 死撑自己只是来喝苹果酒放松，两人互演「毫无评判」。
facts.anchor: Nova is entitled to carry a frozen raven anywhere she pleases

facts.fact: 关系揭示：Rendel 是 Keegan 与 Gideon 的父亲，会变成渡鸦；Nova 把他冻在店里 tarot room 的笼中（for everyone’s safety）。
facts.anchor: carrying Keegan and Gideon’s dad around

facts.fact: 旅店渊源：离婚后闺蜜 Skye 请 Maeve 来此散心；如今 Skye 家庭日增、两人疏远，但仍每两周互发短信，Maeve 答应过要去看她。
facts.anchor: since my friend Skye treated me to a getaway there after my divorce

facts.fact: Ember 一眼拆穿：Nova 提着瘫痪渡鸦过街约五分钟后，Maeve 就装作有正事的模样进门。
facts.anchor: pretending you had somewhere perfectly normal to be

facts.fact: 门外偷听到分歧：Nova 反对不自然唤醒，Keegan 更硬——I don’t agree to this。
facts.anchor: “Waking him unnaturally is going to complicate things,” Nova said

facts.fact: Nova 每日检查封印：今晨魔法变薄、能感到下面的他；Keegan 说 He’s starting to wake up from the spell。
facts.anchor: “The magic around him is thinner. I check it every day. This morning, I could feel him underneath it.”

facts.fact: 时间对齐：Celeste 影印今晨发麻十秒——Maeve 本以为是聊 Shadowick 所致，现在与 Rendel 封印变薄指向同一时刻。
facts.anchor: Celeste’s mark had tingled earlier today.

facts.fact: Gideon 判定他魔力仍在（Keegan 补 Or getting there）；Maeve 要醒时别让 Celeste 靠近，他多半会发怒（He’s probably going to be angry）。
封印若失效大概会变回人形；Nova 摊手说这没有说明书（There aren’t exactly instructions for this, Maeve）。
facts.anchor: “He’ll probably return to his human form.”

facts.fact: Gideon 低声提醒：一直加固封印的后果无人知晓，他的语气显示他知道得比说出的多。
Keegan 本是要下楼来叫 Maeve（warmth spread through me）；Gideon 冷脸相对（Against my better judgment）。
章尾 Gideon 盯着 Rendel 断言影子要来了；「Rendel knows more than he’s ever told us」——所以要让他醒。
